text: I studied econometrics, not computer science. That background still shows up in how I work: I like data, patterns, and things that can be measured.

Somewhere along the way I fell into frontend development and never left. Eight years later, I've shipped public-facing platforms and internal tools alike, worked inside teams of 3 to 10 people, and picked up a habit of caring more about load times than anyone asked me to.

Right now I'm expanding into full-stack development with .NET Core and C# — partly for the career flexibility, partly because I just like understanding the whole system, not only the part rendered in the browser.

Outside of work, I'm a cat person (dog person too), a lifelong Fenerbahçe fan, and someone who's been curious about technology since childhood — long before it became a career. I'm also, slowly, teaching myself to draw.
